ai_summary: CP Capital Limited reported robust standalone financial performance in Q1 FY27, with PAT growing 102% QoQ and a significant improvement in gross asset quality as the Gross NPA ratio halved to 8.9%, with nearly all NPAs being secured. However, this cleanup coincided with a 10% reduction in the gross loan book and a notable increase in the Net NPA Ratio from 6.7% to 7.3%, warranting further scrutiny despite strong collateral coverage.
